t003:
WISH I HAD A
NEW HELPER
ROBOT, BUT
MONEY IS TIGHT

notes: Retains desire for a helper robot, the bad local economy and the contrast that it costs less on Ulyria. The subject is implicit in the last page.

t003:
I NEED A
STEADY INCOME
TO PROPOSE.
I MAY RUN A

SCRAP SHOP
AND MAKE A
FORTUNE.

notes: Retains the need for steady income before proposing and the hoped-for fortune from a scrap shop; the intended partner remains unnamed.

inGameEnglish.t003:
HE'S NO OLD
GEEZER! SCRAP
SHOPS ARE SO
OUT OF STYLE.

notes: Keeps her dismissive reaction to a non-elder running an unfashionable scrap shop; no objective claim about the trade is added.
Conversational subject omitted in the game line to keep the complete canned-food item and delayed delivery; explicit row breaks keep the colored item separate.

t003:
HEY, KID.
SCARY MEN HANG
OUT IN THE
BAR BELOW.

notes: The shortened header identifies her heavy makeup; “kid” retains her teasing address, and the warning keeps the underground bar, scary men and advice to avoid them.

inGameEnglish.t003:
SWORDS BEAT
GUNS IF YOU'RE
STRONG.

notes: Keeps the conditional sword-over-gun advice and the speaker's claim that it is not for children; the second source span starts a new row after its wait.
The unspecified object remains “it”; the second source span begins a new rendered row after a wait that does not clear the page.
Preserves the drunk’s conditional-seeming sequence, irritation and sleep. An explicit continuation page is needed because source wait controls do not clear the dialogue box.

inGameEnglish.t006:
THEY SAY THEIR
BELLIES HOLD
EVEN SCRAP!

notes: Retains oversized insects eating anything and the explicitly hearsay claim of scrap in their bellies.

inGameEnglish.t003:
WORLD'S TOO
RIGID FOR A
FREE LIFE.

notes: Keeps the outlaw’s complaint that a rigid world leaves too little room to live freely; no plan or destination is implied.

t003:
WEY DUMNA
SETTLED
WISPERARD
300 YEARS AGO.

IF ITS PEOPLE
GO TO WAR,
IT'S ALL OVER.

notes: Preserves both provisional proper names, the 300-year settlement reference and the man’s warning; “settled” condenses the founding pioneer description.

inGameEnglish.t003:
NO MERCY IN
WAR. HARDEN UP
OR YOU'LL DIE!

notes: Retains the older woman’s severe warning that mercy in war can get the listener killed.

inGameEnglish.t003:
I'LL WORK HARD
FOR A SHIP OF
MY OWN, THEN
SAIL THE STARS

notes: “Sail the stars” retains the source’s ocean-of-space image while keeping his earnest ambition; the future departure remains a hope, not an accomplished plan.
